ship_handoff.description: Final ship-readiness handoff combining release notes and PR status.

intent.goal: Use the `babysit-poll` plugin tool to fetch the current state of pull request `123` (run `babysit-poll --help` if you need exact syntax, then call `babysit-poll --pr 123`). Combine the polled JSON with the release-notes draft to produce a short ship-readiness handoff.
acceptance_criteria: The handoff cites the release notes and plugin-produced PR status evidence.
The node does not mutate repository files or remote services.
constraints: Do not modify files in the repository.
